title: Music for the tavern and a new face for the website
text:
Recorded tavern music on the title screen and in Hearthmere, and a redesigned home page.

✨ Real tavern music: three recorded medieval tavern tracks (By the Rafters' Glow and Embers on the Flagstone by Kaazoom, and Medieval City Tavern by DeusLower) now play in shuffled order on the title, loading and character screens and whenever you are in Hearthmere. They fade in as you walk into town and fade out as you leave
⬆️ The music starts with your first click or key press on the title screen (browsers do not allow sound before that), and follows your Music and Master volume settings
✨ A redesigned website home page: new painted artwork of Hearthmere by the lake under the glowing Cinder Caldera, drifting embers, a smoother slow camera drift, and a cleaner, more spacious layout
